decisions.reason: The image-count instruction is an independent clause already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; specifying internal-link destinations does not change the image requirement.
The source specifies internal-link destinations within a blog and does not change the requirement to produce three blog articles.
Adding product and related-blog links does not change the publication destination or publication unit.
The source refines the internal-link requirement but does not alter the existing client-approval gate for publication.
Internal-link destinations do not change the AI-dolls blog's target audience.
The source does not add, replace, or remove any blog keyword target.
The instruction about blog internal links does not change the website SEO keyword count or replacement keyword.
The source has no effect on whether search-volume data must be included in the keyword list.
Specifying blog-link destinations does not change the approved replacement terms or webpage content-replacement scope.
The blog internal-link instruction does not affect homepage H1 usage or website heading hierarchy.
The source does not change the requirement to optimize meta titles and descriptions.
Internal links within a blog are distinct from the off-page backlink campaign and do not change its count, types, or percentages.
